{{Quote|Ahsoka, this is Mina Bonteri. She was my mentor when I was growing up on Naboo.|Padmé Amidala introduces Bonteri to Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="HOBS" />}}
'''Mina Bonteri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] until she joined the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Parliament]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:BonteriAmidalaMeet-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|Bonteri and Amidala reunite to discuss peace talks]]
Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Bonteri mentored [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Bonteri also had a child, [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]], with her [[Mina Bonteri's husband/Legends|husband]].<ref name="HOBS" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the war, Bonteri had joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and formed part of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]]. She was an admirer of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] for standing up to the Republic, which she viewed as corrupt. Her husband was sent to [[Aargonar/Legends|Aargonar]] to set up a base. However, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attacked.<ref name="HOBS" />

Bonteri was later contacted by Amidala in an attempt to broker peace between the Republic and the Confederacy. She called for a vote to open [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace talks]] with the Republic, which was passed by the Separatist Parliament, but her efforts were thwarted by a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|terrorist attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] organized by Count Dooku and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="HOBS" />

Bonteri died shortly thereafter, and while Dooku publicly attributed her death to a [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|Republic attack]], some Republic spies instead reported that it was Dooku's agents who had killed her.<ref name="POP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name and photo of Bonteri was featured in [[Star Wars Insider 121|''Star Wars Insider'' 121]], released on [[October 26]], [[2010]]. She later appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," where she was voiced by [[Kath Soucie]], who also voices Republic Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].
